summary: Activity Log Phase 1 — backend end-to-end pytest suite passing 11/12 (one expected SKIP). Frontend browser test was BLOCKED because the public preview URL (lab-traceability.preview.emergentagent.com) is currently served by the Emergent 'Preview Unavailable!!!' landing page (the Agent is resting after inactivity), so neither /api nor / are reachable through the k8s ingress. Local backend on :8001 verified fine; nginx on :3000 serves the Next.js bundle but does NOT proxy /api locally, so a browser-mode UI test against localhost wouldn't be representative either. Backend instrumentation is solid: client_created, client_updated (summary mentions changed field), job_created (visible under job_id filter), job_status_changed (summary contains from→to transition), stone_verbal_entered, stone_fees_updated, stone_cancelled (via DELETE /jobs/{id}/stones/{stone_id}), shipment_created (per-job AND in global feed), shipment_status_changed (from→to in summary), login_success, plus 401 on unauthenticated GET /api/activity, plus newest-first sort. Code review of JobActivityList.tsx + jobs/page.tsx wiring shows the component is gated by `isAdmin && selectedJob` at line 1872 and uses correct data-testid props ('job-activity-list', 'job-activity-empty', 'job-activity-error', 'activity-row-{action}').

minor.issue: Test skipped because freshly-created test job had $0 balance (fees aren't materialised at create-time for the synthetic minimal stone we used). Not a code defect — endpoint validation correctly rejects amount>balance. Manual-payment activity path is therefore not covered end-to-end by the automated suite; recommend running this manually against a job with a non-zero net total, or seeding total_fee in fixtures.

action_items: Optional: enrich the manual-payment test by pre-seeding total_fee on the test job (or by reusing an existing unpaid job) so the payment_recorded activity row is exercised end-to-end in CI.

Once the preview URL is back online, re-run the frontend Playwright flow: (a) open Jobs page, (b) click a job row, (c) scroll the dialog body, (d) assert [data-testid=job-activity-list] is visible with rows, (e) edit Notes → Save → reopen dialog → assert a new activity-row-job_updated appears.

Consider also writing a backend test for job_notification_sent (currently uncovered) once email/SMS test doubles are available — the helper logs on success only, so a real test would either need a mocked Resend response or a careful test-only address.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/activity_log.py: log_activity() resolves actor_id via actor.get('_id') or actor.get('id') — for documents coming straight from MongoDB the _id is an ObjectId, which would be stringified via str(); that's fine, but actor_id type is then inconsistent between login (string) and elsewhere (could be ObjectId-as-string). Consider always running it through _to_string_id().

/app/backend/routes/activity.py: super_admin can pass an arbitrary branch_id query param to scope the feed — good — but there's no validation that the branch exists. A bogus branch_id silently returns []. Low impact, but a 404 would be clearer.

/app/backend/activity_log.py: TTL = 365 days. The docstring says '12 months hot + archive cold' but no cold-archive job exists yet. Document the deferred work in the ROADMAP if not already, so we don't lose history when TTL fires.

/app/frontend/src/app/dashboard/jobs/_components/JobActivityList.tsx: formatRelative() uses `new Date(iso).getTime()` — backend returns ISO with timezone offset (good). No abuse of toLocaleString in test envs, all relative. LGTM.

/app/frontend/src/app/dashboard/jobs/page.tsx is 2086 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting the Job Detail dialog into a dedicated component; the activity card is already extracted, but the surrounding dialog body is becoming hard to navigate.

Each run creates a fresh set keyed by uuid4 — main agent may want to bulk-delete these later (filter client.name like 'TEST_ActivityClient_%').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are reusable: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_activity_log.py with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8001 (or the public URL when the preview is awake). The suite expects TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY blanked OR a fresh Turnstile token; the test reads /api/auth/login directly with website='' honeypot. For frontend, once preview is online use the iter35 auth-bypass pattern: page.request POST /api/auth/login → page.evaluate sets sessionStorage 'token' + 'auth-storage' ({state:{token,user,isAuthenticated:true},version:0}). The JobActivityList card is rendered inside the Job Detail dialog at the very bottom under a 'border-t pt-4 mt-4' divider — you need to scroll the dialog body to see it. Selectors confirmed in code: [data-testid=job-activity-list], [data-testid=job-activity-empty], [data-testid=job-activity-error], [data-testid^=activity-row-]. Uncovered: job_notification_sent (needs mocked email send), payment_recorded (needs job with non-zero balance).
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as specified server-side. Frontend test is blocked by infra (preview env asleep), not by code. The single skipped backend test is a fixture limitation, not a defect.
